findings.reason: the plan must either restrict the count to duties whose snapshot computed_at is at or after the review's launch (the reader was true when the duty was computed) or accept §16's stale snapshots, in which case §11's "zero review-missing duties sampled while their review run was live" cannot hold and its done-when is unattainable.
findings.text: §11 counts a review-missing duty whenever obligations._current_review_in_flight is true at the moment the sampler reads it, and asserts that equals "published while a review run standing for that run was live"; a snapshot whose computed_at predates the review pointer's created_at (exactly the case §16 records: "a snapshot that predated the review's launch") is read after the launch, returns true, and is counted, so §11 conflates §16's stale-snapshot cause with its own defect

rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §11 evaluates obligations._current_review_in_flight at sample time and claims "a duty sampled while it returns true is the defect and nothing else is", but a snapshot computed before the review launched (the stale-snapshot cause §16 identifies) returns true when read after the launch, so the instrument cannot separate §16's cause from §11's defect and its zero target contradicts §16's "lands no product change" branch.
